svg.title: June's forearm: the List in biro
svg.desc: June's forearm laid along the frame by firelight, the inside of the arm toward us, written over from wrist to elbow in blue biro: the nineteen things of the List in order, small and crowded, the later ones squeezed in round the curve of the arm, some smudged by a thumb. No face, no hand gesture; only the arm on a dark sleeve and the firelight.
